note.after_visit_summary: You have a mild worsening of your heart failure, likely due to eating salty food and taking naproxen for your knees. We found swelling in your legs, weight gain, and increased shortness of breath. To help, stop naproxen completely and use acetaminophen (650 mg up to 3 times daily) for knee pain instead. Increase your water pill (furosemide) to 40 mg twice daily for 5 days, then go back to 40 mg daily once your weight is near 183 lbs. Keep taking your other heart medicines as before. Weigh yourself each morning after using the bathroom and write it down. Limit salt to under 2000 mg per day and fluids to about 2 liters daily. We will check a blood test on the 21st of October to monitor your kidneys and potassium. Call us if your weight goes up 3 lbs in one day or 5 lbs in one week. Go to the emergency room if you have shortness of breath at rest or chest pain. Follow up in 1 week to check your weight and swelling.
